entries.title: I Chronicles 14:2
segments:
Lifted up on high; greatly strengthened and prospered. 
 
All blessings, temporal and spiritual, come from God.  When this is duly acknowledged, it honors him and prepares the way for the increase and continuance of his favors.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:8
segments: Great mercies are often followed by great trials; but careful inquiry as to the will of God, adn a readiness when it is known to obey it, will secure his aid, and in due time give deliverance from trouble, and victory over every foe.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:9
segments: The valley of Rephaim; near Jerusalem on the south-west.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:10
segments: Go up; to the head-quarters of the Philistines, from which they spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:11
segments: Baal-perazim; near the valley of Rephaim on the south.

entries.title: I Chronicles 14:16
segments:
Gibeon; in the tribe of Benjamin. 
 
  Gazer; one of the cities of the Philistines.
